subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as plugin-owned opt-in buffers, as a shared channel SDK/gateway media coalescer, or deferred to narrow channel bugs?
rationale: The choice changes turn boundaries, latency, reply-token lifecycle, config shape, and plugin/core ownership, so automation should not pick the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
options.body: Start with the affected channel plugin, key by account/conversation/sender, flush before same-key text/control events as specified, and reuse shared helpers only when they avoid real duplication.

options.title: Shared SDK/gateway coalescer
options.body: Design a generic media coalescing contract before channel-specific implementation, accepting a broader compatibility and SDK review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep text debounce and Telegram album handling as the supported behavior, then track only narrow channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss separately.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
recommendation.body: Start with the affected channel plugin, key by account/conversation/sender, flush before same-key text/control events as specified, and reuse shared helpers only when they avoid real duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available owner for a cross-channel policy/config boundary decision tied to the shared debounce and plugin surfaces.
